content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the RGU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download RGU Teaching Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Teaching Assistant: M.Sc in Chemistry with minimum 55% marks (or equivalent) from accredited Indian/foreign University. Must have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test like SLET/SET. PhD awarded candidates exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Desirable: Ph.D degree and teaching experience preferred.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Consolidated salary: Rs. 1,000/- per class to maximum of Rs. 40,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: RGU Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this RGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Teaching Assistant. This is a contractual position offered by Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Teaching Assistant post in this recruitment drive by Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this RGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc in Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent. Additionally, clearing NET/SLET/SET or having a PhD exemption is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is on a consolidated basis, ranging from Rs. 1,000/- per class to a maximum of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Teaching Assistant post is scheduled to be held on 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this RGU recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of Rajiv Gandhi University?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi University is located in Doimukh, Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Teaching Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Teaching Assistant role will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed during this interview.
